<function name="Saved" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>
Called when the game is saved using the Source Engine save system (not the Sandbox saves or dupes).

See <page>GM:Restored</page> for a hook that is called when such a save file is loaded.

See also the <page>saverestore</page> for relevant functions.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
</function>
